environment.description: Terraform provider binary running as terraform-runner service account on Ubuntu 22.04 host. Provider executes during `terraform apply` with standard Linux DAC permissions. The service account has read/write access to /var/lib/terraform-provider-custom/ and general filesystem access. No mandatory access control policies are loaded. AppArmor is installed but in complain-only mode (aa-status shows all profiles in complain). The provider process can write to arbitrary paths accessible by the service account uid.
